description: Java class defining a generic asynchronous service job, including methods for execution, initialization, completion, failure handling, and state management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericServiceJob
classes.description: A class representing a generic asynchronous service job in the OFBiz framework, capable of executing services, handling states, and managing success or failure scenarios.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the service job, invoking the specified service synchronously and handling success or failure.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service job before execution, with verbose logging if enabled.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks the service job as finished successfully, with verbose logging if enabled.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios, logging errors and updating the job state.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the context map for the service invocation.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to invoke.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the job is in a valid state for execution.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Prevents dequeuing of the job, throws exception if attempted.
